scope: Native Fountain browser editor in the actual GitLab application; partial toolbar/providers, not full product acceptance
checks: Normal web sign-in and authenticated API version match the image/source pin
Real private project, PNG upload and issue created through authenticated GitLab HTTP APIs
Real browser clipboard Markdown renders through the actual GitLab service, inserts with reference/marks, and supports one-step undo/redo
An actual unsupported GitLab-rendered footnote leaves the document untouched, exposes exact retained source and recovers through a later supported paste
mermaid: the actual block-type selector creates a new block; native multiline typing and real preview work, and delete/undo/redo retain every source character
plantuml: the actual block-type selector creates a new block; native multiline typing and real preview work, and delete/undo/redo retain every source character
Real GitLab Markdown imports Mermaid code and the enabled PlantUML image/source carrier into native editable source blocks without flattening the diagram
The script-only real Mermaid sandbox renders a diagram; actual invalid native typing produces a recoverable preview error, and Undo restores source and a working preview without page errors
Native multiline editing updates the actual Mermaid preview, and Copy code writes the complete updated source to the real browser clipboard
Actual offline PlantUML preview failure retains the source; explicit online retry uses GitLab rendering and decodes the real isolated PlantUML server image
Actual PlantUML source editing updates a real image; conversion to ordinary code and one-step undo retain every source character
Diagram deletion/undo retains source; the restored real sandbox works at 360px without horizontal page overflow, and the preview region has no axe violations
The real paired Mermaid dialog shows source and rendered output together; invalid local source exposes an error and copies exactly, while Cancel leaves the committed diagram unchanged
A valid paired-source draft previews before committing, Apply updates the intended block in one step, Undo/Redo retain the exact source, and the entire dialog has no axe violations
The paired PlantUML draft uses the actual configured image renderer, stacks source and preview at 360px without horizontal overflow, and Apply commits the source for normal GitLab saving
Native Fountain toolbar formats actual browser selection; undo and redo update both document and view
Rebuilt real host hands current rich content to source mode and reopens it without a stale cached value
Actual UI Save retains both edited diagram sources; the GitLab reader renders the published Mermaid node and decodes the actual PlantUML provider image
Native rich typing and UI save persisted the added paragraph and retained the seeded content in the server record
An actual empty comment paints its placeholder, hides it on focus/typing and restores empty state after real comment persistence
An initially empty native Fountain composer creates a real GitLab discussion comment and clears after successful persistence
Actual unsupported saved Markdown refuses editing through Retry; explicit recovery enables a local draft, cancelled without changing the server original
Private issue is unavailable to an unauthenticated browser context
Exact saved server source, authenticated session and uploaded image survive an actual application-container restart
secrets: Password/session used in memory only; no traces or storage-state files

nativeRuntime.scope: Native Fountain/GitLab integration runtime; not a deployed or complete GitLab replacement
